skills.name: gui_list_windows
skills.description: List Cua Driver GUI windows with their exact process and window IDs before inspecting or clicking one.

skills.name: gui_inspect_window
skills.description: Read accessible controls in one GUI window. Use IDs from gui_list_windows. A degraded result cannot be used for element clicks; an incomplete tree may still contain valid exact tokens.

skills.name: gui_click_element
skills.description: Click an accessible control using an exact element token from a recent non-degraded gui_inspect_window result. Inspect the changed window again afterward.

skills.name: gui_observe_desktop
skills.description: Capture a current desktop image with Cua Driver for visual GUI interaction. Only use coordinates if the result says frame_submitted and you perceive the target.

skills.name: gui_click_desktop
skills.description: Click a visible desktop coordinate from the most recent gui_observe_desktop frame. Observe again after each click. Some Hyprland surfaces cannot receive driver input.

target_window_id.description: Optional window_id from gui_list_windows to verify coordinates fall inside target window geometry.

verify_active.description: Verify the target window is the currently active/focused window before clicking.

skills.name: gui_scroll_desktop
skills.description: Scroll the current GUI after a fresh gui_observe_desktop frame. Observe again afterward; Hyprland may report an unverifiable effect.

target_window_id.description: Optional window_id to verify scroll point falls inside target window.

skills.name: gui_type_at
skills.description: Focus a visible text field at desktop coordinates and type text with Cua Driver. Requires a fresh submitted desktop frame; observe again afterward.

target_window_id.description: Optional window_id to verify typing coordinates fall inside target window.

skills.name: gui_key_at
skills.description: Focus an observed desktop location and send one key or shortcut through Cua Driver. Requires a fresh submitted frame; observe afterward.

target_window_id.description: Optional window_id to verify key point falls inside target window.

skills.name: gui_browser_bind
skills.description: Bind an exact browser window from gui_list_windows to Cua's tab controls. If the browser lacks a DevTools endpoint, report that limitation and use visual desktop controls.

skills.name: gui_browser_open_isolated
skills.description: Open a separate Cua-owned isolated Chrome window for exact browser tab control without changing the user's existing browser profile. Then list and bind its window.

skills.name: gui_browser_snapshot
skills.description: Read the semantic page and fresh element refs for an exactly bound browser tab.

skills.name: gui_browser_click
skills.description: Click a fresh exact page ref in a bound browser tab using the available Cua route; then inspect the tab again to verify activation.

skills.name: gui_browser_type
skills.description: Type or replace text in an editable fresh page ref in a bound browser tab; then inspect the tab again.

skills.name: gui_browser_navigate
skills.description: Open an http, https, or about URL in an exactly bound Cua browser tab, then inspect the new page.

skills.name: gui_browser_double_click
skills.description: Double-click a fresh page ref in an exactly bound browser tab, then inspect the page to verify the result.

skills.name: gui_verify_window
skills.description: Verify that an exact window exists, or that it contains a labeled accessible control. Unknown or unsatisfied is not success.
